segments.title: This 'unicorn horn' is a TOOTH
segments.say: This unicorn horn is actually a tooth. It's a narwhal's tusk.

segments.title: Up to 2 metres long
segments.say: It can grow up to two meters. That's about half the narwhal's body.

segments.title: Two spirals inside
segments.say: Scans found two tiny spirals inside. They twist in opposite directions, like rope.

segments.title: That keeps it strong
segments.say: Scientists say that helps keep it strong.
